stance: Housing is weak but stabilising at a low level. September existing sales of 3.99M SAAR (+1.5%, after -3.2%) edged past consensus, yet the series is a lagging closings count and mortgage rates near 7.4% threaten affordability. Expect softer prints in October and November. No history yet, so the view is provisional. Permits and new home sales (leading) would confirm or contradict any recovery.
